title: Doozy Vape Co Big Drip Lemon Cake Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Lemon Cake shortfill e-liquid by Big Drip is a delicious blend that captures all the comfort of a light sponge cake, filled with lemon curd and sharp, zesty lemon icing. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
